description:
Signal to Noise, a crew of CS Data Science students who have some experience in computer vision and ML, are joining the SARs to dance. We will be mapping the flooding in the Philippines using the NISAR radar that can penetrate clouds, and create an interactive change-detection map, along with ML water segmentation.

We are seeking web developers (maps/frontend), data analysts and a designer or storyteller for our pitch. The following are desirable: an interest in Earth Science.
